statements.statement: The patient presents with recurrent episodes of dizziness and presyncope attributed to sick sinus syndrome
The patient has a recent history of transient cerebral ischemic attacks
Cardiac event monitoring (CPT 93271) is indicated for further diagnostic assessment
The diagnoses addressed are I49.5 and G45.9
The denial reason code is CO-97
The denial is based on the service being bundled into another covered procedure
The monitoring service is not reimbursable as a standalone item when performed in conjunction with the primary diagnostic evaluation
